An existing loan of %s was detected and automatically repaid. The amount has been deducted from your balance.
Use the Bank menu to take out a new loan.
Bank-side metrics. Overview of the bank's financial foundation: equity, lending capacity, utilization, and leverage.
Bank-side metrics. Measures how well the bank covers potential losses and your farm's concentration within the portfolio.
Distribution of outstanding loans by risk level. More high-risk loans means less available credit.
The bank's own capital, built from initial capital and accumulated interest income. Every interest payment you make strengthens the bank and increases its lending capacity.
Maximum amount the bank can lend across all farms. Equals equity multiplied by the leverage ratio. When exhausted, no new loans can be issued.
Sum of all remaining principal owed across every farm on the server. Used to compute the bank's utilization rate. The higher this amount, the lower the available lending capacity.
Percentage of total capacity currently lent out. Below 50% = healthy 50-80% = tight Above 80% = very limited credit available
Multiplier applied to equity to determine lending capacity. E.g. 10x = each $1 of equity supports $10 in loans. Set by the server administrator.

Measures whether the bank has enough reserves to cover the risks in its loan portfolio. Formula: Equity ÷ Loss provisions. Above 1.5x = healthy 1.0–1.5x = warning Below 1.0x = critical A low ratio may block the approval of new loans.

Funds set aside to absorb potential loan defaults. High-risk loans require larger provisions, which directly reduces the bank's effective lending capacity. This is an internal bank reserve, not a reimbursement of player loans.
Click a title or indicator for details
Fixed monthly payment, same every month, combining interest and principal. The instalment never varies over the entire term.
Interest-only monthly payments. The full principal is repaid in a single lump sum at the end of the term. Lower monthly outgoings but plan your cash flow at maturity.
A permanent credit line up to your approved limit. Draw what you need, repay freely. No fixed instalment, no set end date.
Close this credit line? This cannot be undone.
Annual 1% fee on the undrawn portion of the credit line. Charged monthly on the unused available amount. Shows the maximum amount (line fully undrawn).
Usage breakdown of your revolving credit line. The limit is the maximum authorized amount. The drawn balance is the amount currently borrowed.
Maximum amount you can borrow on this revolving credit line.
Amount currently borrowed and in use on this credit line.
Amount still available to draw from your credit limit.
Financial terms applicable to this revolving credit line.
Estimated monthly interest based on the current drawn balance.
Estimated annual interest based on the current drawn balance.
Revolving credit lines have no fixed term. They remain open until closed.
Revolving payments are variable: you pay monthly interest on the drawn balance. Principal is repaid at your own pace.
You must own a farm to request a loan.
Minimum partial repayment is %s (10%% of the initial capital).
Total amount borrowed when the loan was signed. This amount does not change during the contract.
Annual interest rate applied to this loan. It includes the bank's base rate plus any surcharge linked to the risk level.
Repayment method for the loan Amortizing : fixed monthly payment, same every month Bullet : interest only monthly, principal repaid at maturity Revolving : open credit line, no fixed term
Risk level assessed by the bank at approval. It depends on DSCR, LTV and your history. Higher risk means a rate surcharge.

Debt Service Coverage Ratio Your income divided by total monthly debt payments. Above 1.5 = comfortable 1.0–1.5 = tight Below 1.0 = income does not cover debts
To improve your DSCR: Repay existing loans (reduces monthly payments) Increase farm income (sales, crops, livestock) Request a lower amount Extend the loan duration (reduces monthly payment)
Loan To Value Loan amount divided by the value of your assets. Lower is safer for the bank. Above 80% = high risk.
Click a label for more details
Requested amount exceeds your available credit limit.
Requested amount exceeds the single-farm exposure cap (25% of total bank capacity).
Loan refused: your financial profile does not meet the minimum criteria.
Invalid amount: please select a positive value.
High risk: the disbursed amount will be capped to 50% of your request.
Click DSCR or Risk Level to understand why your application was declined.
Confirm a loan of %s at %s rate?
Breakdown of the interest rate applied to your loan. The final EIR is the sum of the base rate, product spread, and risk surcharge.
Reference rate set by the bank, the same for all borrowers. It changes based on server settings.
Rate premium linked to the chosen loan type. Amortizing = 0%: capital reduces with each payment. Bullet: full capital exposed until maturity. Revolving: capital on demand with no fixed end date.
Premium applied based on your risk level. The riskier your profile, the higher this surcharge.
Effective Interest Rate: the true annual cost of your loan. It combines the base rate, product spread, and risk surcharge.
Risk assessment of your loan by the bank. These indicators determine whether the loan is granted and under what conditions.
Summary of the total cost of your loan. Compares the monthly payment, cumulative interest, and total amount to repay.
Amount deducted from your cash each month. For an amortizing loan, it includes principal and interest. For a bullet loan, only interest is deducted.
Sum of all interest you will pay over the loan term. The longer the duration, the higher this amount.
Total amount you will have repaid by the end of the loan. Equal to the borrowed principal plus total interest.
Initial credit amount made available to each farm for banking operations.
Defines the maximum borrowing multiple of available equity. E.g., 10x means max credit = 10× equity.
When enabled, the base rate follows monthly trends. It may remain stable or move by 0.25%, 0.50%, and exceptionally 0.75%. Risk surcharges always apply.
Annual base interest rate applied to all loans, before risk surcharge.
Percentage of outstanding principal charged as a penalty for early loan repayment.
No annual report data available yet.
